source_notes: This is an explicitly chosen Oteryn finite programme supplementary to the existing original SourceQuest identity. The original missions, interactions, claims, gates and UNKNOWN holds are retained; no duplicate canonical quest is created.

All quantities, requirement thresholds, sequencing, repeat policy and reward delivery are CHOSEN_OTERYN_APPROXIMATION, even when the same name or number occurs in a pinned source. Entity names are unresolved authored binding requests, never fabricated native IDs, Lua symbols or storage aliases.

Completion concerns only this chosen recipe. Unselected optional branches, full source fidelity, drop rates, original schedules, transport logic and executable Native delivery are not certified. Intermediate collect/use stages acquire and consume their own tools; reward_intents lists only final or stated milestone grants.
Original source identity: canary:quest/killing_in_the_name_of_quest@canary-04b83b51+crystalserver-9f5a72c6; inherited source pins and catalogue title links are preserved exactly.
The inherited Source minimum level is unknown/absent. Zero is explicitly selected for Oteryn, not a promotion of the missing Source fact to KNOWN.

stages.objective: Join Grizzly Adams' hunting programme in Port Hope.
Hunt three hundred Crocodiles for the first chosen task.
Find the Snapper hideout and defeat its dangerous crocodile.
Report the crocodile task and Snapper victory to Grizzly.
Hunt one hundred fifty Carniphilas for the second chosen task.
Find Deathbine's hideout and defeat it.
Report the second task and obtain the chosen next-rank qualification.
Hunt six hundred fifty Hydras for the final chosen task.
Defeat The Many in the unlocked hideout.
Report the completed campaign to Grizzly.
Record the completion of the chosen Killing in the Name of... Quest programme and its selected reward intents.
